test_title: PYST 173: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 16th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark(?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10b1c13ea29321958cc3f0ab07233810b1286ccb070d0f8f6d6846acaffd9cb2.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark(?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• One sided arrow present in pentagon moves one step clockwise.
 
• From 1st figure to 2nd figure an one sided arrow line moves one step clockwise and represents with two sided arow line.
 
• From 2nd to 3rd figure an two sided arrow line moves one step clockwise and represents with one sided arrow line.
 
• From 3rd to 4th figure an one sided arrow line moves one step clockwise and represents with two sided arow line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec73efe7401c26f0f2787098739b97f2a1a03629088c56aba731294e5ab1d727.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
